subject: economics
objective: What compound growth rate does this series imply?
instruction: Harbourview's real output was USD 52,000,000 in the first year of a review and USD 61,880,000 in the last, and the population rose from 400,000 to 436,000. The report does not say how many years separate the two observations. Use compound (geometric) annual rates: g = (end / start)^(1/periods) - 1, applied separately to output, to population and to output per person. Periods are years. Required: average annual growth rate, per capita annual growth rate.
